metadata.notes: Test suite covering listing types, common fields, type-specific validations, state transitions, and publishing across all 5 listing types.

test_cases.scenario: Select Standard listing type on Step 1 -> Type is selected and description is displayed
preconditions: Seller is logged in and on Step 1 of listing creation.
steps: View Step 1 'What are you listing?' screen.
Click on the 'Standard' listing type card.
test_cases.expected_result: Standard radio button is checked, one-line description 'Fixed price. Paid when the order is confirmed.' is visible, and the user navigates to Step 2 'Item details'.
postconditions: Draft is created with type Standard.

test_cases.scenario: View ineligible Luxury listing type -> Card is disabled with reason and qualification path
preconditions: Seller has 4 completed orders and lacks KYC completion.
steps: Navigate to Step 1 'What are you listing?'.
test_cases.expected_result: Luxury listing type card is visible but disabled (grayed out) with text 'Needs KYC and 10+ completed orders (you have 4)' displayed in red/orange.

test_cases.feature: Common Listing Details and Draft Management
test_cases.scenario: Auto-save draft on step change -> Draft is saved automatically
preconditions: Seller has entered valid common details on Step 2.
steps: Fill out valid common details on Step 2.
test_cases.expected_result: Draft is auto-saved immediately upon clicking Next, and user transitions to Step 3 without data loss.

test_cases.feature: Common Listing Details and Draft Management
test_cases.scenario: Enter title below minimum character limit -> Inline validation error is shown
steps: Enter 'Sony' (4 characters) into the Title field.
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error 'Title must be 10 to 80 characters' is displayed below the Title field, and 'Next' button remains disabled or blocks progression.

test_cases.feature: Common Listing Details and Draft Management
test_cases.scenario: Enter title exceeding maximum character limit -> Inline validation error is shown
steps: Enter an 81-character string into the Title field.
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error 'Title must be 10 to 80 characters' is displayed, blocking progression.

test_cases.feature: Common Listing Details and Draft Management
test_cases.scenario: Enter description below minimum character limit -> Inline validation error is shown
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error 'Min 50 characters' is displayed below the description field.

test_cases.feature: Common Listing Details and Draft Management
test_cases.scenario: Upload photo exceeding 10 MB size limit -> Validation error code 413 is triggered
steps: Click photo upload button and select an 11.5 MB JPG image.
test_cases.expected_result: Upload fails with error 'Media file exceeds 10 MB limit' (HTTP 413 MEDIA_TOO_LARGE), and the photo slot is marked as failed without corrupting other draft data.

test_cases.scenario: Configure Buyer Protection listing -> Protection fee and payout timeline are displayed correctly
preconditions: Seller selected 'Buyer Protection' on Step 1 and completed common details with price ₹18,500.
test_cases.expected_result: Banner shows 'Your listing gets a Buyer Protection badge...', Protection fee is calculated as ₹370 (2%), Buyer pays ₹18,870, You receive ₹18,500, Tracked shipping toggle is enabled by default, and payout timeline message is displayed.

test_cases.scenario: Enter Luxury price below ₹50,000 threshold -> Inline error blocks publishing
preconditions: Seller selected 'Luxury' on Step 1 and is on Step 3 'Luxury details'.
steps: Blur price field or attempt to proceed.
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error 'Luxury listings must be ₹50,000 or more' is displayed in red, price border turns red, and progression to preview is blocked.

test_cases.scenario: Submit valid Luxury listing -> Listing enters Pending Review state
preconditions: Seller completed Luxury details with price ₹75,000, brand, model, serial number, proof of purchase, and all 4 required photos.
test_cases.expected_result: Listing is successfully submitted and state becomes 'Pending Review' (Status: Pending Review, Type: Luxury) with message 'Sent for authentication. Most checks finish within 48 hours.'
postconditions: Listing state in DB is PENDING_REVIEW.

test_cases.scenario: Set OM minimum offer higher than asking price -> Inline error blocks progression
preconditions: Seller selected 'OM (Offer Mode)' and entered asking price ₹22,000.
steps: Enter ₹24,000 into the Minimum offer field.
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Must be less than or equal to the asking price' is displayed in red below the minimum offer field, and progression is blocked.

test_cases.scenario: Fetch buyer-facing API/view for OM listing -> Minimum offer is excluded from payload
preconditions: OM listing with asking price ₹22,000 and hidden minOffer ₹18,000 is published.
steps: Send GET request to `/v1/listings/{id}` using a buyer auth token.
test_cases.expected_result: Response contains asking price and offer expiry, but `minOffer` field is completely stripped by the buyer-facing serializer.

test_cases.scenario: Receive offer below OM minimum offer -> System automatically declines the offer
preconditions: OM listing is live with asking price ₹22,000 and hidden minimum offer ₹18,000.
steps: Buyer submits an offer of ₹16,000 via the offers service.
test_cases.expected_result: The offer is automatically declined by the system because it is below the hidden minimum offer of ₹18,000, and notification reflects the declined status.
postconditions: Offer status is set to DECLINED.

test_cases.feature: Bulk Listing Type and Tiered Pricing
test_cases.scenario: Enter non-decreasing bulk price tier -> Inline error is displayed and publishing blocked
preconditions: Seller selected 'Bulk' and is on Step 3 'Bulk pricing'.
steps: Enter Tier 3 with quantity 500 and unit price ₹110 (higher than previous ₹105).
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error 'Tier 3 must be cheaper than ₹105' is displayed in red, highlighting the offending tier row.

test_cases.feature: Bulk Listing Type and Tiered Pricing
test_cases.scenario: Attempt to publish Bulk listing with unverified GSTIN -> Publishing is blocked with error
preconditions: Seller account has unverified GSTIN and is creating a Bulk listing.
test_cases.expected_result: Publishing is blocked, and an error message is displayed stating that GSTIN verification is required before publishing a Bulk listing.

test_cases.scenario: Preview Buyer Protection listing -> Preview matches buyer view exactly
preconditions: Seller completed all steps for Buyer Protection listing.
test_cases.expected_result: Preview screen renders title, photos count, correct calculated price (₹18,870), condition, category, returns policy, and the green 'Buyer Protection' badge with escrow info banner.

test_cases.scenario: Publish listing successfully -> Confirmation screen displays listing ID, status, and link
preconditions: Seller is on Step 4 Preview screen with a valid Standard draft.
steps: Click 'Publish' button with a valid Idempotency-Key header.
test_cases.expected_result: Listing is published, transition succeeds, and confirmation screen displays success checkmark, Listing ID (e.g. LST-8F3K2Q), Type, Status 'Live', and a 'View listing' link.

gaps.description: Network drop recovery during parallel photo uploads (retry 3 times)
gaps.reason: Requires simulated network interception tooling in E2E automation rather than functional API/UI tests.

coverage_summary.notes: Coverage is robust across listing types, eligibility rules, common field validations, type-specific pricing/authentication rules, and state transitions. All 15 requirements and 10 acceptance criteria identified in the PRD are fully covered by test cases. Non-functional requirements regarding performance and accessibility are noted as out-of-scope for functional test execution.

requirements.text: The type selector is the first step, displaying all 5 listing types with a one-line description and eligibility status.
Ineligible listing types are visible but disabled, displaying the reason and instructions on how to qualify.
The system shall auto-save drafts every 10 seconds and upon step changes.
All common listing fields (Title, Category, Condition, Description, Photos, Quantity, Shipping, Pickup location, Return policy) must be validated according to defined rules.
For Buyer Protection listings, display the protection fee and payout timeline before publishing, and require tracked shipping to be enabled.
Buyer Protection listing cards and detail pages must display a Buyer Protection badge.
Luxury listings require a price of at least ₹50,000, along with brand, model, and serial number inputs.
Luxury listings require proof of purchase upload and at least 4 photos including serial number and logo close-ups.
On submit, Luxury listings enter Pending Review state until authentication passes, then become Live with a Verified Luxury badge.
For Offer Mode listings, sellers set an asking price; minimum offer is optional, must be <= asking price, and is never shown to buyers.
Sellers set offer expiry (24, 48, or 72 hours), and offers below the minimum are auto-declined.
Bulk listings require MOQ and up to 5 price tiers, where each tier's unit price must be strictly lower than the previous tier.
GSTIN must be verified on the business account before publishing a Bulk listing.
The preview screen must render the listing exactly as a buyer sees it, per listing type.
Publish confirmation must show listing ID, status, and a link to the listing.

acceptance_criteria.text: Seller can select any of the 5 listing types on Step 1.
Ineligible types are disabled with a visible reason and path to qualify.
Draft auto-saves and restores after closing browser or app.
Buyer Protection badge shows on the listing card and detail page.
Luxury listing below ₹50,000 cannot be published.
Luxury listing stays Pending Review until authentication passes.
OM minimum offer is never returned in any buyer-facing API or page.
OM offers below the minimum are auto-declined.
Bulk tiers with non-decreasing prices are rejected with an inline error.
Preview matches the published buyer view for every type.

business_rules.text: Title must be 10-80 characters, no phone numbers or URLs.
Photos must be 1-10 images, JPG/PNG/WEBP, max 10 MB each, min 800x800 px.
OM minimum offer must be less than or equal to the asking price.
Bulk price tiers must contain up to 5 tiers, and each tier's unit price must be strictly lower than the previous tier.
